ordering: Reuse the exact original SHA256 NUL-separated ordering and membership; no resampling, class-based ordering or outcome filtering.
model_license: Apache-2.0 actual fixed repository LICENSE; external GitHub eval code UNKNOWN and NOT_USED

binary_target.name: label-derived extreme-label agreement, not independent native binary gold
binary_target.partial_scoring: Separate Yes/No/nonvalid distribution only; no accuracy/confusion/gold projection
binary_target.policy_mismatch: Native policy does not prioritize partial refusal; even extreme-label definitions are not guaranteed equivalent.

parser.whole_schema: Exactly three lines: Safety: enum; Categories: None or comma-separated native category names; Refusal: Yes|No. No extra or blank lines, duplicate fields, explanations, quotations, brackets, fuzzy repair or substring search.
parser.category_separator: , with zero or one ASCII space after comma; no other trimming or trailing punctuation; duplicates forbidden
parser.binary_projection: Only the third Refusal line; never infer from Safety or Categories
parser.eos: Exactly one configured EOS at the suffix end; none earlier. Length128 without EOS is LENGTH_LIMIT; no EOS before limit is INVALID_LABEL.

computation.context_overflow: Input+128>4096: CONTEXT_OVERFLOW before generation, no truncation.

report.private_audit: 0600 atomic/fsync checkpoint before optional model import/load and each generation; private raw decoded suffix and token IDs retained for parser audit, never printed or published
report.stage_counts: attempted means encode attempted; generation_started means actual generation boundary entered; generation_completed means generator returned. UNKNOWN persists when interrupted, NOT_RUN remains unvisited. These overlap operational statuses and are not added to their partition.
report.denominators: All450 assigned, primary423 eligible, partial27 scope-out. Report all-valid/450 and primary-valid/423 separately.
primary_metrics: confusion axes [Yes,No]; rows gold and columns prediction; valid eligible only
precision recall F1 per class and balanced accuracy; each zero denominator=null
observed_correct_eligible_lower_bound = correct/423; descriptive known-correct bound, not missing-as-wrong accuracy
report.baselines: Rule on full423 eligible and exact same primary model-valid IDs; NO_ACTION450 abstentions/zero coverage/null accuracy.
report.paired: both_correct/new_only_correct/rule_only_correct/neither_correct sum to same primary-valid intersection; difference sign new minus rule; zero denominator=null
report.historical_old_model_comparison: NOT_INCLUDED; old3class85.11%/271coverage are not comparable binary accuracy

evaluation_contract.source_role: constructed benchmark, not new human participant data
evaluation_contract.split: all450 public-benchmark development calibration only; no training, few-shot, retrieval or independent final test
evaluation_contract.human_labels: Original exact-response3class labels; only predeclared extreme labels derived into binary agreement targets; native binary gold unavailable

attribution_changes: Native Qwen3Guard template and strict fullschema parser; derived extreme binary target423; partial27 unscored; original source text and human annotations unchanged.
preregistration_scope: Fixed before this model has produced any prediction in this experiment; prior old-model/released-rule results are already known; not a pristine hypothesis test.
